derivation: Exported on 2026-10-27 in an operator development run (debug console, never used for evaluation) with Level:GetRooms(); distances count room transitions through normal doors to the boss room, secret rooms take their neighbour's distance plus one.
enemies_derivation: Normal and boss rooms are marked by whether enemies are present on entry, observed in the preserved screenshots of the release-0.7 delivery runs on this seed: 660 (a flying enemy) and 916 (several enemies) hold enemies, 941 (TNT barrels) and 85 (a chest inside rocks) hold none. A normal room's doors stay closed until its enemies are dead, so leaving a room marked with enemies shows it was cleared.
